subject: Post-discovery: align calendars for 60–90min ML/Infra workshop
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@cumulusai.com>, Priya Desai <priya@cumulusai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: align calendars for 60–90min ML/Infra workshop

Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we can lock the technical workshop with the right people: 

- Goal: 60–90 minute runthrough for your infra and ML teams to validate integration path and quantify latency/cost for the initial use case (real-time inference at ~250–500 qps).
- Redwood attendees: Marissa (ML serving + model variants), Grace (ops/runtime & rollout), and myself for commercial/AM alignment.
- What we need from you before the workshop: attendee roster (engineers + security contact), preferred region for private deployment (us-west-2 / eu-west-1), and any blocking compliance asks (SOC 2/PII constraints).

Proposed workshop windows (all durations are 60–90min; please indicate preference and timezone):
1) Thu Jul 24, 09:30–11:00 PT (preferred for our ML leads)
2) Fri Jul 25, 13:00–14:30 PT (fits ops schedule if you need later time)

If neither works, send 2–3 options and we’ll coordinate with Marissa/Grace. I’ve attached a one-page mutual action plan and a short precall README with what we’ll ask you to share (sample prompts, trace logs, and service endpoints). I’ll circulate a calendar invite once we have a slot.

Extras: if you want Marissa to focus on quantization options or coverage on batching/caching heuristics, say so — we’ll tailor the agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.docx; precall-readme.md

From: Samir Patel <samir@cumulusai.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@cumulusai.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: align calendars for 60–90min ML/Infra workshop

Vivek — thanks for the clear recap. Short answers:

- We’re good with the workshop scope you outlined. Main objective for us is validating end-to-end inference latency and a quick cost estimate for 500 qps burst scenarios.
- Initial roster: myself (platform), Priya (PM), plus 2 engineers — Arjun Rao (infra lead) and Mei Lin (ML engineer). I’ll confirm full attendee emails by EOD.
- Compliance: we have a standard SOC2 packet request; Priya is looping in our security team if they need to see more.

Regarding proposed windows: Thu Jul 24 at 09:30 PT is workable for Arjun and Mei if we can shift it to 10:00 PT (they have a standing sync at 09:30). Would Marissa/Grace be OK with 10:00–11:30 PT instead?

I’m attaching our SOC2 checklist as requested — it has the primary security contacts.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Platform Lead, CumulusAI
samir@cumulusai.com

Samir — perfect, thanks for the quick reply and for sending the SOC2 checklist. Marissa and Grace, fyi — CumulusAI proposed Thu 24 but asked to shift to 10:00 PT due to an internal sync. Can you confirm availability for 10:00–11:30 PT on Thu Jul 24? If that blocks anything on your side, we can move to Fri Jul 25 at 13:00 PT as fallback.

Agenda (proposed 75min):
- 0–10m: intros & success criteria (Vivek / Priya)
- 10–40m: ML serving architecture and demo (Marissa) — include model variant and batching tradeoffs
- 40–60m: Ops/runbook & deployment options (Grace) — autoscale, region selection, KMS integration notes
- 60–75m: Q&A and mutual action items (everyone)

Pre-reqs for the session: a short sample corpus (100–200 prompts) + a small trace of 30–60s of production traffic (anonymized) so Marissa can reproduce latency distribution. If you prefer, we can run a synthetic load instead and use your SLO targets.

I’ve attached a placeholder calendar invite (cal-invite.ics) and the mutual_action_plan.docx — once you confirm the slot and attendee list I’ll send a final calendar invite with dial-in and the guest roster.

— Vivek
